meta.name: Powder
meta.description: An insight of the drug lord, Naved Ansari, and an honest team of Narotics Control Bureau led by Usmaan Malik IRS who plans to nab Ansari before he can hoodwink the system into letting him go scott free.

videos.title: A Drug Lord Called Naved Ansari
videos.overview: A drug kingpin's younger brother is arrested by the police. Now, the NCB intends to go after the main guy.

videos.title: Infighting Sabotages a Mission
videos.overview: Ansari plans to shift to Karachi. Meanwhile, problems arise due to the difference in opinions of Brinda and Mahendra.

videos.title: Drug Raids Across The City
videos.overview: All the perpetrators caught by the NCB are granted bail. NCB chief asks Usmaan to let Naved go for now and get more petty arrests to boost their numbers. Problems between Brinda and Mahendra continue.

videos.title: Brinda Proves her Worth
videos.overview: Brinda gets tipped off about Naved's new shipment and NCB tries to inflict as much damage as possible.

videos.title: The Battle Against Drug Trade
videos.overview: Brinda represents NCB Mumbai in an international conference on the battle against drug trade. Pinto escapes from police custody. Ansari goes to Dubai to discuss future drug trade ambitions with his boss.

videos.title: An Associate's Murder
videos.overview: Leading the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), Usmaan Ali Malik and his team set on a hot pursuit of the drug baron Naved Ahmed Ansari and his gang of peddlers.

videos.title: Brinda Follows Ansari's Trail
videos.overview: Brinda continues pursuing the case of Jagat Tripathi's murder and its connection with drug smuggling. Usmaan tries to convince his boss to nab Ansari before its too late.

videos.title: A Foe Turned Friend?
videos.overview: Brinda and Mahendra are on their way to Chamba to nab Raja. Ansari wants to get out of the country as soon as possible. Usmaan and Kartik come across an angry mob while arresting a criminal.

videos.title: DRI Decides to Trump the NCB?
videos.overview: Mahendra and Brinda gather information about drug trade in Chamba. Usmaan takes a reluctant drug addict to a rehabilitation center. Karthik is given a tip about a huge drug cartel in Rajasthan.

videos.title: Ansari's Brother Rises
videos.overview: Ansari makes plans for the future of his drug empire and makes sure that Wasim can work in his lieu. Brinda and Mahendra continue their work in Chamba. Raghav, a rival of Ansari, is released from jail after a long time.

videos.title: Danger in Disguise
videos.overview: Mahendra and Brinda try to nab Raja but find that he's holding two hostages and plan to free them and also arrest him.

videos.title: A Failed Mission
videos.overview: Wasim asks Rati to marry him. Naved's drugs are stolen from his warehouse and his boss in Dubai negates his initial offer to shift to Dubai.

videos.title: Ansari Under Surveillance
videos.overview: NCB and DRI are trying to get Ansari at Wasim's wedding. Brinda is still bummed out as she is being kept out of this.

videos.title: Ansari's Change of Plans
videos.overview: ANC, NCB and DRI are all getting closer to Ansari. Brinda is arresting a lot of people in Rajasthan who are part of a drug cartel.

videos.title: Crackdown on Ansari
videos.overview: Usmaan is frustrated that DRI and ANC are doing better than them in the Ansari investigation. DRI is following Ansari's money trail. Brinda asks for Mahendra's help with nabbing a drug-related chemical manufacturing company.

videos.title: NCB tightens its hold
videos.overview: NCB surveils Ansari very closely after he returns from Burma. Brinda comes back to office. Mahendra tries to sort out his issues with Kartik.

videos.title: Container Surprise
videos.overview: NCB and ANC try to seize Ansari's drug consignment in a joint operation. DRI joins in but separately. Ansari is monitoring the shipment as well as each and every movement of all these organisations and is still not cancelling the shipment. What's his plan?

videos.title: An Untimely Death
videos.overview: After Kartik's death, everyone is devastated. They try to find inconsistencies in the facts of the demolition of the building that was supposed to be the cause of Kartik's death.

videos.title: Wasim to the Rescue
videos.overview: A new officer joins NCB. Mahendra thinks Raja killed Kartik and wants to take revenge. Brinda stops him and makes him join her and her former acquaintance in a fight against drugs and Kartik's killers. Jagdale may also join them.

videos.title: The Karthik Conspiracy
videos.overview: Ashwini is pissed as DRI handed over all their investigation to NCB. The new hire, Shiven, finds a breakthrough in the case. Usmaan adds Brinda, not Mahendra, to the Ansari taskforce. Jagdale pretends to show interest in a bribe from Dayal.

videos.title: The DRI crackdown
videos.overview: DRI approaches minister Jagat Tripathi to get Ansari's case from NCB. Raghav offers to become a witness against Ansari. Mahendra and Jagdale play their own cards in order to bring down Ansari.

videos.title: The Political Intervention
videos.overview: NCB finds the guy who killed Rajesh. That guy named Raja as the person who hired him and so NCB is going to arrest him. Ansari comes to know about this and asks Wasim to get Raja killed, which he agrees to.

videos.title: A Leak in the NCB?
videos.overview: Rati comes to know about her brother's death but doesn't say anything during interrogation. Shiven returns as an injured hero. Everybody at NCB is disappointed as Ansari has escaped the country.

videos.title: Mahendra in Trouble
videos.overview: Dayal finds out that the money he gave to Jagdale has come back to him. Ansari and Dayal set up a trap in order to figure out what exactly is happening. Ashwini asks Bose to contact RAW and ask them for a favor.

videos.title: The Final Plan in Motion
videos.overview: Jagdale is arrested on anti-corruption charges. Brinda informs NCB about Mahendra's drug deal. Brinda asks for Ashwini's help to transport Mahendra after he's arrested.

videos.title: Usmaan-Ansari Face Off
videos.overview: Wasim intends to flee to Bangkok. Ansari's partners think that Wasim has got something to do with all the NCB's raids. Vigilance department issued a summon for Brinda as she was seen helping Mahendra escape.
